name: Spero: The Forest Dwellers
source:
Miyu grew up hearing tales of the world outside the forest. The forest guardian, Heidi, sealed the forest one day... preventing people from coming in and stopping the village from leaving.

On the festival day though... strangers enter the forest.

With Heidi missing, what will Miyu do?

[From [url=http://www.azuretales.co.uk/SperoFD.html]Azure Tales[/url]]
